children: Gold, stocks, and Bitcoin crashed hard over the past month. But one of the few places investors could avoid the sell-off was the US dollar.
A Coinbase Institutional report published Friday found that the dollar strengthened 2.5% in the month to November 18. It was the only gainer among 14 assets and benchmarks tracked.

image.alt: One-month total returns across 14 assets through November 18.

children: Why Is the US Dollar Beating Everything?
The explanation starts with the Federal Reserve.
showed nearly all officials expect further interest-rate increases to fight inflation.
Meanwhile, the inflation-adjusted yield on 10-year US government bonds has climbed near an 18-year high.

That makes holding dollars more attractive. Investors can earn interest on dollar deposits or short-term US Treasury bills. Gold and Bitcoin pay no interest, while higher borrowing costs put pressure on businesses and stocks.
Coinbase calls the reversal an unwind of the “debasement trade,” the popular bet that a weaker dollar would push gold and Bitcoin higher. Both have now fallen together.
Should Investors Start Saving in Dollars?
That depends on what they need the money for. Someone holding euros, for example, could benefit if the dollar keeps rising.
But the 2.5% gain measures the dollar against other currencies. It is not a guaranteed return on dollar savings, and exchange rates can quickly reverse.
The broader message is that markets expect borrowing costs to remain high. The US Dollar Index has climbed near 103.8, its highest since April 2025.
Views on what happens next differ. Family office manager Canarinho sees continued dollar strength, citing long-term support.
Crypto analyst Ted Pillows sees fading momentum and says a drop below 102 could help Bitcoin and altcoins recover.
The next test is the Fed’s December 8–9 meeting. More hawkish signals could keep the dollar strong and other assets under pressure. A softer outlook could reverse that trade.
For now, the dollar’s lead shows how much markets fear prolonged high interest rates.

title: US Dollar Beats Bitcoin, Gold and Stocks as Fed Rate Hike Fears Grow
